name: pebble
description: Pebble's island for Windows: jump from the island to the exact terminal tab that runs your agent, and (optionally) hear when a long terminal command finishes.

pebble.notifyLongCommands.description: Tell Pebble when a terminal command that took a while finishes. Leave off if Pebble already added this to your shell (tray → Terminals), or you get it twice.

pebble.minSeconds.description: How long a command must run before Pebble tells you it finished.
